I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I hear you. When you’ve been let down before, it’s hard to trust the next purchase, especially in the garden where it takes time to see results.

A couple of things about Heirloom that may help:

All of our roses are premium own-root plants grown in 1-gallon containers at our nurseries in Oregon (not bare root, not sourced from third parties).
Each plant is individually tended and inspected, and our roses are defoliated before shipping so they travel better and put energy into establishing once planted.
We back our roses with a one-year guarantee and our perennials with a 90-day guarantee, so you’re not on your own if something doesn’t perform.
